newsitem.title: USA: Northfield says FDA clears Phase 3 trials.
newsitem.headline: Northfield says FDA clears Phase 3 trials.

text.p: Northfield Laboratories Inc said Wednesday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to begin Phase III trials with the company's blood substitute, PolyHeme.
Surgical patients will be infused with six units of PolyHeme in the trials, Northfield said.
The randomized, controlled study will include about 250 elective surgery patients and is expected to last 12 months, Northfield said.
The six-unit level represents about 60 percent of an adult's entire blood volume, Northfield said.

"Northfield ... is the only firm to report successful achievement of this high dose limit in any phase of clinical testing, and the only firm to evaluate its oxygen carrier as a direct replacement for blood in high volumes in a Phase III study," said the development stage company.
